tools.name: evaluate_video_publish
tools.description: Free Chinese video publishing checklist for six platforms. Draft self-reports only; missing evidence stays needs-info. Gives editorial experiments, never viral probability, platform approval or algorithm scores. Fields reach BPJ; no files, URLs or scripts accepted.

tools.name: get_video_platform_rules
tools.description: Read dated official-source evidence and separately labelled editorial checks for Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Weixin Channels and Toutiao. Inaccessible or unverified source status remains explicit; no private platform data.

tools.name: search_manju
tools.description: Search the currently published Chinese AI video/manju catalogue by title, genre and tags, with source dates and official/search/introduction destinations. Read only, no crawl on miss. Heat is not plays; source_rank requires one cohort. Results may include seasons.
